description: Minimal compatibility corrections; original exploration FSM, frontier and TSP strategies remain unchanged.

patches.new:
find_path(NLOPT_INCLUDE_DIR nlopt.hpp HINTS /usr/local/include)
find_library(NLOPT_LIBRARY NAMES nlopt HINTS /usr/local/lib)
if(NOT NLOPT_INCLUDE_DIR OR NOT NLOPT_LIBRARY)
  message(FATAL_ERROR "NLopt C++ headers/library not found. Install libnlopt-cxx-dev or set NLOPT_INCLUDE_DIR and NLOPT_LIBRARY.")
endif()
patches.reason: Locate the installed NLopt instead of requiring /usr/local/lib/libnlopt.so. No planning behavior changes.
Allow callers to stop when waypoint trajectory construction fails.
Discard invalid waypoint results rather than retaining a previous trajectory.

Reject invalid/degenerate paths, insert a midpoint for the upstream polynomial two-point limitation, and sample both endpoints without floating-step overshoot. No new objective, dynamic limit, timing stretch, or stop policy.

patches.new:
if (!planner_manager_->planExploreTraj(ed_->path_next_goal_, vel, acc, time_lb))
      return FAIL;

if (!planner_manager_->planExploreTraj(truncated_path, vel, acc, time_lb))
      return FAIL;

patches.reason: Reject invalid yaw results and avoid reading an empty previous waypoint on a stationary/vertical segment. Official yaw objective and boundary treatment are unchanged.
Exclude zero duration, where spline derivatives and optimization expressions divide by zero. Historical compatibility fix, not a different exploration policy.
Initialize the existing solver fallback instead of reading an empty or stale vector when NLopt throws before evaluating.
Declare std::isfinite explicitly for the input checks.
Do not publish an invalid yaw trajectory if its input or solver output was rejected.
Default preserves the official up/down initialization. When explicitly true, a connected Gazebo adapter must perform the same sequence; trajectory handling after startup is unchanged.
Test the current pixel depth, which was read before advancing row_ptr, rather than the next pixel or a pointer beyond the last sample. Depth fusion policy is unchanged.
Initialize valid index bounds before ROS timers can publish or inspect the map; leave all occupancy values unknown as in the official initialization.

patches.old: if (optimize_time_) gt += dq.dot(q1 - 2 * q2 + q3) / (-dt * dt * dt);
patches.new: if (optimize_time_) gt += 4.0 * dq.dot(q1 - 2 * q2 + q3) / (-dt * dt * dt);
patches.reason: Correct only the time derivative of the unchanged squared acceleration-boundary error: d(||B/dt^2-a||^2)/d(dt) = -4*(B/dt^2-a).dot(B)/dt^3. The official formula omitted the factor 4; central finite differences verify this correction.

patches.old: if (optimize_time_) gt += dq.dot(q_1 - 2 * q_2 + q_3) / (-dt * dt * dt);
patches.new: if (optimize_time_) gt += 4.0 * dq.dot(q_1 - 2 * q_2 + q_3) / (-dt * dt * dt);
patches.reason: Correct only the time derivative of the unchanged squared acceleration-boundary error: d(||B/dt^2-a||^2)/d(dt) = -4*(B/dt^2-a).dot(B)/dt^3. The official formula omitted the factor 4; central finite differences verify this correction.
